article.title: Destruction of unclaimed documents.
article.content:
85Destruction of unclaimed documents.

Section 85  ·  Part XV  ·  page 55 of the Act
Documents (other than wills) remaining unclaimed in any registration office for a period exceeding two years may be destroyed.
